import os,sqlite3,json,hashlib
root=r'E:\WebAIBridge\chrome-profiles\chatgpt-ChatGPT_2-ef72920c'
cands=[os.path.join(root,'History'),os.path.join(root,'Default','History')]
hist=next((p for p in cands if os.path.exists(p)),None)
if not hist:
    print(json.dumps({'error':'HISTORY_NOT_FOUND','checked':cands},ensure_ascii=False)); raise SystemExit(0)
uri='file:'+hist.replace('\\','/')+'?mode=ro&immutable=1'
con=sqlite3.connect(uri,uri=True)
rows=con.execute("SELECT url,title,last_visit_time FROM urls WHERE url LIKE 'https://chatgpt.com/%' AND instr(url,'/c/')>0 ORDER BY last_visit_time DESC").fetchall()
con.close()
seen=set(); items=[]
for url,title,ts in rows:
    if url in seen: continue
    seen.add(url)
    items.append({'key':hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest()[:16],'title':' '.join((title or '').split()),'url':url,'last_visit_time':int(ts or 0)})
os.makedirs(r'C:\rehearsal',exist_ok=True)
out=r'C:\rehearsal\coord-chat-index-20260930.json'
with open(out,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump({'history':hist,'items':items},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'count':len(items),'local_index':out,'items':[{'key':x['key'],'title':x['title'],'last_visit_time':x['last_visit_time']} for x in items[:120]]},ensure_ascii=False))
